about: Scott M. Dimond attended law school and graduated from Columbia Law School in 1993. Scott Dimond began practicing law in 1993.

Scott Dimond is an attorney at Homer Bonner Jacobs Ortiz & Dimond, P.A., helping people with Business Litigation issues. Homer Bonner Jacobs Ortiz & Dimond, P.A. has an office in Miami, Florida, serving the local community.

Scott Dimond was selected to Super Lawyers for 2008 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
